description: Header file for STM32F4xx HAL Flash Extension module, defining types, constants, and function prototypes for flash memory operations and configuration.

methods.name: HAL_FLASHEx_Erase
methods.description: Performs flash memory sector or mass erase based on provided parameters.

methods.name: HAL_FLASHEx_Erase_IT
methods.description: Performs flash memory sector or mass erase in interrupt mode.

methods.name: HAL_FLASHEx_OBProgram
methods.description: Programs the option bytes of flash memory.

methods.name: HAL_FLASHEx_OBGetConfig
methods.description: Retrieves current flash option bytes configuration.

methods.name: HAL_FLASHEx_AdvOBProgram
methods.description: Programs advanced option bytes for specific features like PCROP and boot configuration.

methods.name: HAL_FLASHEx_AdvOBGetConfig
methods.description: Gets current advanced option bytes configuration.

methods.name: HAL_FLASHEx_OB_GetBank2WRP
methods.description: Retrieves write protection status for bank 2 sectors.
